content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Coordinator Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Starts at 09:00 AM; closing time 10:00 AM
Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, Second Floor, Medical College Building, Room No. 211, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur, Basni, Phase 2nd, Jodhpur - 342005
Candidates with MBBS/BDS (preferred)/health sciences and demonstrated interest/experience in clinical/translational research or health innovation

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur and the Project
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is located at Basni Industrial Area Phase-2, Jodhpur - 342005 (Rajasthan), and was established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. The Project Coordinator post is in the extramural funded research project titled "Genetic and Epigenetic Markers of Silicosis Susceptibility among Mine Workers in Jodhpur: A Case-Control Study". The project runs under Principal Investigator Dr. Pankaja Ravi Raghav, Professor and Head, Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, AIIMS, Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Experience in clinical research or health innovation. Knowledge of research ethics and medical innovation projects will be an advantage. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis. The notice marks this as "Only Applicable for ICMR Project". Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, and it is based on the experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates. The position will be purely on a temporary/contractual basis for the specified period of time and based on the project. The post is co-terminus with the project, and the selected candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur or continuation of his/her services in any other project.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Overall conduct, coordination and supervision of all research activities. Handling participant recruitment, field visits, and procurement inventory. Maintaining records, data entry and statistical analysis. Report writing, budget management and demonstrating a leadership role. Performing other duties assigned by the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled application in the prescribed format (the "Format for Application" printed on page 4 of the notice), with a photograph pasted in the box provided. Bio-data. All relevant original documents. One set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. All essential qualification and experience certificates, enclosed with the application form; otherwise the application will be considered incomplete. A "No Objection Certificate", for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting for candidates starts at 9:00 AM on 07/12/2026. Reporting closes at 10:00 AM on the same day; no additional candidates will be entertained for the interview after that. Candidates submit the filled application and Bio-data and appear in person with their documents. The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants. Candidates then appear for the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts may increase/decrease as per requirement and at the sole discretion of the Principal Investigator, AIIMS, Jodhpur. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Coordinator walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Reporting starts at 09:00 AM on 7 December 2026 and closes at 10:00 AM; no additional candidates are entertained after 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, Second Floor, Medical College Building, Room No. 211, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur, Basni, Phase 2nd, Jodhpur - 342005.

faq.question: Q4. How many Project Coordinator posts are there?
faq.answer: There is one Project Coordinator post, though the post may increase/decrease as per requirement at the sole discretion of the Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for the Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS/BDS (preferred)/health sciences, with demonstrated interest/experience in clinical/translational research or health innovation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, with age, qualification and experience considered till the last date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of the Project Coordinator?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 79,365/ month, a consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring the filled application in the prescribed format, Bio-data, all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a test before the interview?
faq.answer: The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Coordinator job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary/contractual for one year, co-terminus with the project, with no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur.
